description: Search, read and audit the mail Thunderbird already downloaded — offline, read-only, no credentials.

novel_features.name: Awaiting reply
novel_features.description: See every thread where someone is waiting on your answer, across all accounts, oldest first.

novel_features.name: Correspondents ranking
novel_features.description: Rank the people you exchange mail with by volume and recency, and spot frequent ones missing from your address book.

novel_features.name: Filters audit
novel_features.description: Check every message filter: how often it matches, whether it is disabled, and whether its target folder still exists.

novel_features.name: Largest items
novel_features.description: Find the biggest messages or attachments across all accounts and folders.

novel_features.name: Newsletters and bulk senders
novel_features.description: List mailing lists and bulk senders by volume and how much of their mail you never read.
